entities.summary: Lipsko is a town in eastern Poland, Masovian Voivodeship. It is the capital of Lipsko County. The population is 5,895 (2004). Lipsko's coat of arms is the Dębno, which was used by previous owners of the town. It is located in the historic region of Lesser Poland.
